svg.title: ShohojRIn single-canvas logical ERD in Chen notation
svg.desc: A single Chen-style logical entity relationship diagram with entity rectangles, attribute ellipses, relationship diamonds, directional connectors, and cardinality labels.
svg.text: ShohojRIn Logical ERD - Single Chen-Style Diagram
Rectangles = entities · Ellipses = logical attributes · Diamonds = relationships · Underlined attributes = primary keys · Labels on connectors show cardinality
